name: sds-ezy-demo
description: A chemical register with a hazard risk assessment for each chemical, drafted from an uploaded safety data sheet. Runs entirely on Cloudflare (Workers, D1, R2).

DB.description: The SDS EZY database. Created for you in your Cloudflare account; the tables are created and brought up to date by the Worker itself the first time it runs after each deploy, and nothing is lost when you redeploy.

FILES.description: Storage for the safety data sheet PDFs, audit photos and your logo (an R2 bucket). Created for you. R2 may ask for a payment method before it can be switched on, even though normal use stays inside the free allowance.

AI.description: Cloudflare Workers AI reads the safety data sheets, with nothing to set up. You can use your own Claude, OpenAI or Gemini key instead in Settings after the first sign-in.
